title: Jamaican Pappardelle Pasta
description: A spicy and aromatic Jamaican-inspired pasta dish, perfect for a romantic dinner.
instructions: Cook the pappardelle pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and bell pepper and cook until tender.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomato sauce, Jamaican jerk seasoning, and diced tomatoes.
Stir to combine and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and let sauce simmer for 10-15 minutes.
Stir in coconut milk and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Combine cooked pappardelle pasta and sauce in a large bowl.
Toss to combine and serve hot.
Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro or scallions, if desired.
